name: RÆD PIZZA
kurzbeschreibung:
**Discover authentic Italian flair in the heart of Tirol!**

At **RÆD PIZZA** in **Innsbruck**, you’ll find more than just pizza—you’ll experience a true taste of Italy. Our wood-fired pizzas are crafted with passion, using only the freshest ingredients, from sun-ripened tomatoes to creamy mozzarella. Whether you crave a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a unique creation like our **Tiroler Special**, every bite is a celebration of flavor.

But that’s not all! Our menu also features delicious **Pasta**, crispy **Calzones**, and refreshing **Salads**—all made with love. And don’t forget our selection of fine **Italian wines** and craft beers, perfect for pairing with your meal.

**RÆD PIZZA** is the ideal spot for a cozy dinner with friends, a quick lunch break, or a romantic evening in **Innsbruck**. Come taste the difference—where tradition meets innovation in every dish.

**Visit us today and let your taste buds travel to Italy!**
